name: Craig's Doors Emergency Shelter
description: Craig's Doors provides vulnerable and unhoused community members with emergency shelter, food, and safety. Its congregate overnight shelter for individual adults experiencing homelessness is open year-round, 7 days a week, and case managers work with guests to find permanent re-housing. Call to check availability.
contact: 413-256-0704 (ext. 1 for shelter); admin@craigsdoors.org; Resource Center, 434 N Pleasant St, Amherst, MA 01002
